correctness.rationale: For the repaired RESULT.md. The frozen proof asserted a short exact sequence of augmented chains: in degree −1 the oriented incidence map has a rank-one kernel, so the left map is not injective. The replacement uses ordinary chains, exact simplex by simplex, and computes ordinary H0 before passing to reduced homology. The joins are homotopy 3-spheres and intersections homotopy circles. The exact sequence identifies H1 with the integral incidence cycle, H2 with the oriented intersection H1 groups, and H3 with the join H3 groups; each identification is an isomorphism, not an extension or a rational rank argument. An outer reflection reverses the incidence orientation in degrees 1 and 2; the degree-3 join swap has parity (1+1)(1+1), so the two endpoint characters are the only signs. Barycentric subdivision removes simplex inversions and rational coinvariants agree with invariants, giving one outer-invariant edge sum; independent inner reflections eliminate each edge and vertex coefficient and outer reflections eliminate degree 1. The frozen verifier and recorded traces for H=C5 were inspected, not executed; the modular check is supplemental and cannot resolve integral exactness.
